name: United Kingdom
first_steps: Resolve whether the event was in England, Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland.
Use Discovery to locate archives; use the relevant nation’s record services.
Follow the event locality to parish, local archive and civil registration holdings.
jurisdiction_questions: Which nation and historical county apply?
For Irish events, what was the jurisdiction at the event date and who holds the records now?

limits: This is an original starter profile, not a complete country guide or a list of confirmed holdings for any person.
Identify the event locality, period and record creator; verify survival, transfers, indexing and image access with the custodian.
Expand beyond these seeds through regional, municipal, religious, institutional and private finding aids. Do not infer birthplace, religion or ancestry from a name.
